Meli is a tiefling pickpocket who works for  Mol's children's gang in the Emerald Grove.
“
You're the first grown-up who's ever gotten in here. Not bad.
„
— Meli, if Mol welcomes the party into the hideout

Involvement

Act One

If  Aradin Beno and his crew leave the Emerald Grove, Meli is in the Tiefling Hideout X: 87 Y: 71, practicing pickpocketing on a dummy.

Pickpocketing Barth

If Aradin's crew stays for a drink, Meli spawns in the Hollow at X: 174 Y: 544 pretending to search an open crate while the crew heads to a nearby table. The party can watch Meli steal a  Brass Locket from  Barth's pocket and run up the ladder where Barth catches him. Initiating conversation with either one allows the choice to intervene and protect Meli, convince him to return the locket, or let Barth do what he wants. This starts ⁠Return the Locket.

There are four options:

  1. Protect Meli: "Don't lay a finger on that child." ( DC 10 Persuasion Check or  DC 10 Intimidation Check) and he runs off with the locket.
  2. Convince Meli to return the locket: ( DC 5 Persuasion Check or  DC 15 Intimidation Check) and he might be persuaded to reveal that he stole the locket because it reminded him of his mother's.
  3. Let Barth strike Meli: the locket falls out of his pocket, and the nearby guard  Ikaron comes over to investigate the disturbance.
  4. If a party member has already pickpocketed the locket from Meli, it is possible to return it to Barth: "He's good, but I'm better." This both impresses Meli and placates Barth.

After the encounter, Meli runs to the Tiefling Hideout near the practice dummy and Barth returns to his crew at the table in The Hollow. If the party speak with Barth afterward, he may reveal that the locket was given to him by his mother while she was on her deathbed. If the party allow Meli to take the locket, it can be recovered from the Tiefling Hideout and returned to Barth. He can then be persuaded to tell a backstory about the locket and its importance to him.

Idle banter

Meli will complain to Mattis as they are packing for Baldur's Gate:

  • Meli
    Hands off, Mattis! I earned this!
  • Mattis
    I helped you earn it.
  • Meli
    Well, I'm stealin' on my own when we get to Baldur's Gate.
  • Mattis
    Fine by me. I bet there's plenty of adults with loose pockets there.

Meli will also be scolded by Mol:

  • Mol
    Can you two help? Anything you don't pack is getting left behind.
  • Meli
    We can always get more stuff later.
  • Mattis
    Yeah! In the city.
  • Mol
    You won't get there if we starve on the way. Gonna rob your friends when you're hungry?
  • Meli
    No way.
  • Mol
    Then pack.
